scope: A only; authored draft scores are diagnostics, never approved semantic accuracy
primary: macro Recall@5 over gold display_candidates questions; each requirement group has equal weight within a question
gate_rationale: Small exposed regression set: preserve its existing coverage and rank as a conservative guard. 250 ms allows about 2.5x the measured offline p95 for extra local processing, not an end-user SLA. Draft negative cases support debugging only. Final semantic acceptance requires reviewed labels and confidence intervals/sample expansion.
comparison_protocol: Same frozen input/gold hashes, corpus snapshot, as_of, mode and scorer version; run old/new in fresh databases. Report paired per-case wins/losses and failures. Never combine draft and inherited or human-reviewed denominators.
future_live_policy: Disabled in Stage 2. Before any live development experiment, separately freeze a user-authorized total call/budget cap and measured latency/cost gates; 0-call offline baseline cannot estimate live model cost. Do not adjust gates after unlocking test.
test_policy: Keep test_expression and test_family locked during development. Freeze reviewed label revision and policy hash before final execution. Corrections after test require a new dataset version and explicit exposure record, not silent relabeling.
human_selection: Actual human and mocked confirmation accuracy remain separate, unmeasured fields. Retrieval Top1 is not user selection accuracy.
